$comment: The on-screen interface's parts that Settings, On screen, can show or hide (owner, 2026-11-06: 'any UI on screen … should be toggle-able from Settings menu and saved across sessions'). Each: id (lowercase words joined by dashes; the stored setting's key), label and hint (the Settings row), selector (the CSS selector of the element(s) it hides), shown (the default), and phone (false: always shown on a touch device, where it is the only way to it: the menu button, whose Esc stands in on a keyboard). Run `node shared/ui/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if client/src/ui/hud.gen.ts is stale. A new part of the HUD is one entry here.

elements.label: Menu button
elements.hint: The ☰ button in the corner (Esc opens the menu)

elements.label: Status line
elements.hint: The world, the connection and its round trip

elements.label: Performance
elements.hint: Frames drawn a second, the CPU's and GPU's time per frame, and the server's ticks

elements.label: Flight speed
elements.hint: The flight speed slider while flying

elements.label: Hotbar
elements.hint: The items, the one held and the build mode

elements.label: Crosshair
elements.hint: The dot in the middle of the view

elements.label: Controls hint
elements.hint: The keys shown when a game starts

elements.label: Notices
elements.hint: Short notes under the crosshair (what can't be placed, and why)

elements.label: Loading chip
elements.hint: The terrain still loading, in the bottom corner
